headline: E. Stroudsburg end Millersville's winning start to conference play
dek: E. Stroudsburg went to Millersville on Saturday and beat a side that had won every conference match it had played. They have lost three times this season and conceded fifteen goals to the fourteen they have scored, yet have still to lose a match that counts towards the table.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Bloomsburg have scored sixteen, more than West Chester and Shippensburg have managed between them, and sit beneath both in the table: goals scored across the season are not what the conference table is rewarding.

wire.line: West Chester are level at the top of the table having scored seven goals all season, the fewest in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Shepherd's home match against District of Columbia is the one date on the record that has passed with no result, and it is Shepherd's alone.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Gannon have not lost since their opening match at home to Lake Erie, winning four and drawing one since, and have conceded eight goals in six matches.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Slippery Rock have conceded five goals in six matches and scored thirteen, with eight different players among the scorers.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Rafael Santos has three goals and five assists from nineteen shots for Seton Hill.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Aidan Houck has made 32 saves for Shepherd and been beaten six times.

last_match.line: E. Stroudsburg had not won away since their trip to Jefferson; Millersville had not lost since Ashland's visit.

next_match.line: E. Stroudsburg have yet to lose in conference play; West Chester's only conference defeat came at Millersville.
